name: outerpale-devops
description: Outer-Pale dev-ops: ties Claude threads, files and artifacts to Linear epics and issues in the Outer-Pale workspace only, asks up front whether a thread needs an epic or is Outer-Pale work at all, and sends sessions to Langfuse. Successor to endstate-ops.

team.title: Linear team key
team.description: Prefix of your Linear issue IDs in the Outer-Pale workspace.

linear_workspace_id.title: Linear workspace ID
linear_workspace_id.description: The only Linear workspace the plugin lets Claude write to. Writes through a connector on any other workspace are refused.

policy.title: Unfiled policy
policy.description: Every unfiled thread is first asked whether it needs an epic and whether it is Outer-Pale work at all. block-outputs (default): until it is answered, the thread can talk but its writes and artifacts wait; after "no epic", documents go in unfiled/. unfiled: warn instead of refusing. block: refuse prompts until an epic is named, or you say "no epic" or "not Outer-Pale".

allow_docs.title: Documents allowed outside the tree
allow_docs.description: Comma-separated globs for .md/.html files that may live outside masters/, epics/ and unfiled/ (shipped guides, READMEs).

root.title: Folder for masters/ and epics/ (optional)
root.description: Where the tree and thread state live. Empty: the nearest folder at or above the session's folder that holds epics/ or masters/ (the project's git repo); else the Claude project's shared folder (/mnt/project-files) when there is one; else the session's project folder.

linear_api_key.title: Linear API key (optional)
linear_api_key.description: An Outer-Pale key lets hooks read issue titles and attach artifact links directly. A key for any other workspace is ignored.

langfuse_host.title: Langfuse URL (optional)
langfuse_host.description: Where sessions are sent, e.g. https://langfuse.example.com. Empty: LANGFUSE_HOST, else nothing is sent.

langfuse_public_key.title: Langfuse public key (optional)
langfuse_public_key.description: pk-lf-… of the outerpale-devops Langfuse project. Empty: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.

langfuse_secret_key.title: Langfuse secret key (optional)
langfuse_secret_key.description: sk-lf-… of the outerpale-devops Langfuse project. Empty: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.

telemetry_content.title: What Langfuse receives
telemetry_content.description: full (default): prompts, replies and tool inputs/outputs. metadata: timings, tokens, tool names and epic/issue tags only.
